metricDefinitions.characterAccuracy: 1 - Levenshtein distance / reference characters after removing whitespace
metricDefinitions.coordinateValidity: share of OCR lines containing four non-negative coordinate pairs
metricDefinitions.elapsedMs: wall-clock inference time; model initialization is excluded
metricDefinitions.peakMemoryMb: maximum process resident memory sampled every 10 ms, including model initialization
metricDefinitions.modelSizeMb: sum of detector, recognizer, and direction classifier ONNX files

rankingRule: character accuracy desc, coordinate validity desc, latency asc, model size asc
